page.overview:
Who is Kinjin?

The most powerful sub-boss, he plays the same as Mokujin and Tetsujin, but gives more rewards than both.

Kinjin is an all-gold, metallic version of Mokujin, sporting a red cape and bow tie, sunglasses, mustache, and a king's crown. While Mokujin and Tetsujin have cylindrical torsos, Kinjin's torso is slightly more rounded, making his shape more akin to that of a barrel.
